## Fundamental Periods and Shear Modulus

### p=mean

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
TBL <- SHT[level==p_TARGET,.(ID,Name,USCS,level,b,s,Hs,Go,VSo,mo,lo,an,Ts)]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE)

```
